title: Universal Joint
model_title: Universal (Cardan / Hooke's) Joint — Input & Output at 25°

introduction.definition: A universal (Cardan) joint connects two shafts at an angle. Each shaft ends in a yoke; the yokes are linked by a cross whose four journals run in needle bearings. Torque passes through the angle, but a single joint makes the output speed fluctuate twice per revolution; two joints in phase cancel this.
applications: Drive shafts of vehicles, rolling mills and paper machines
Steering columns and machinery with offset shafts
key_points: Speed ratio swings between cos β and 1/cos β
Use two joints in phase (Z/W) to cancel
Needles only oscillate — keep a small angle
introduction.summary: A universal (Cardan) joint connects two shafts at an angle using two yokes and a cross with needle bearings. It transmits torque through the angle, but a single joint makes the output speed fluctuate.

pressure.title: Joint angle β makes the output speed fluctuate
pressure.description: A single Cardan joint transmits rotation through an angle, but not at constant speed: the output angular velocity swings between ω·cos β and ω/cos β twice every revolution (for β = 25° about −9 % to +10 %). Two joints with the yokes of the intermediate shaft in phase and equal angles (Z or W arrangement) cancel the fluctuation. The needle bearings in the cross only oscillate, so they need a minimum working angle (≈ 1–2°) to spread grease and avoid brinelling.

script.narration: This module introduces the Universal Joint.
A universal (Cardan) joint connects two shafts at an angle.
Each shaft ends in a yoke; the yokes are linked by a cross whose four journals run in needle bearings.
Torque passes through the angle, but a single joint makes the output speed fluctuate twice per revolution; two joints in phase cancel this.
Typical applications include drive shafts of vehicles, rolling mills and paper machines; steering columns and machinery with offset shafts.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Input Shaft & Yoke with Needle-Bearing Caps, Output Shaft & Yoke (at joint angle β = 25°), Cross (Spider / Trunnion) with Four Journals.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Universal Joint.
Check for play and noise.
Grease the cross bearings.
Replace cross & bearings.
Watch for brinelling of needle tracks: notchy feel. Common cause: zero angle, shock loads.
Watch for vibration: 2× running speed. Common cause: joints out of phase / unequal angles.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.

questions.question: Does a single U-joint give constant output speed at an angle?
options: No — it fluctuates twice per rev

questions.question: How are fluctuations cancelled?
